behavior.commercial: Accepted estimate snapshot captured by SQL, atomic SO numbering, internal confirmation and explicit cancellation; no financial posting, payment or delivery.
behavior.source: Active order protects the exact source via PO008; PO011 blocks premature or mismatched invoice. Explicit cancellation frees the source. Actual ERP invoice link is corroborated; order state never invents an invoiced event.
behavior.invoicing: Confirmed order can use the existing controlled invoice path, with unchanged financial permissions and current tax preparation. Local real SQL cash/accrual paths issue an actual ERP invoice and journal from synthetic tax preparation, then reject cancellation; no real tax provider.
behavior.authority: US/USD, schema4, fresh account/device/browser identity and Gestion membership, expected-user scope; server checks again after waits. Commercial member access does not add financial permission; read_only reads/exports only.
behavior.recovery: RAM-only exact pending command, no replacement on uncertain outcome, matching hashed receipt required. Post-dispatch admission failure cannot be mistaken for proof that the transaction never committed. Certain PO008/PO011 conflicts re-read authority and retain drafts.
behavior.browser: Compact head polling nominal3 seconds online/visible/active. Changed reads keep drafts; actions disabled during a refresh without a loading panel. Stale action versions require review. Source lookup is authoritative outside the current25-item page and renewed on relevant revisions.
behavior.exports: Independent schema1 DTO, US Letter PDF plus HTML/CSV/JSON in four languages. Frozen public seller/customer data only, explicit tax-pending amount, no EIN/secrets. Post-render record validation and browser provenance/length/SHA256 verification.

gates.rollback: Close new; retain history/cancellation/exact replay and SQL guards. No data deletion.

build.notices: Existing vinext middleware/plugin/route classification notices; no compilation failure.

tests.intermediate: Initial broad run had31 failures in the account-page test mock. Dedicated readiness mock and18 security/page tests added; actual missing workbench props discovered and fixed. Final133-file run supersedes that result. Targeted overlapping reports are not added to the total.

browser.contrastScope: Sampled headings, muted copy, toolbar, row amounts and form labels; does not claim every possible state.
browser.keyboardFocus: Observed3px focus on automatically focused form input
